{{Quote|Grand Admiral Batch was assassinated by his second in command, who then took the ships of Batch's task force and joined Warlord Harrsk in the Deep Core.|[[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|''The New Essential Chronology'']]|<ref name="NEC" />}}
[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Martio Batch]] was served by a '''second in command'''.<ref name="NEC" /> Around [[4 ABY]]<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}} establishes that following [[Martio Batch]]'s [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]], his crew joined the newly-formed [[Zero Command|splinter kingdom]] led by [[Blitzer Harrsk]]. As ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that Harrsk's splinter faction was formed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the assassiation of Batch and the subsequent assimilation into Harrsk's faction must have taken place around that year.</ref> the second in command assassinated Batch,<ref name="NEC" /> with the help of his crew. Following the assassination,<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|66|Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], leader of the splinter faction [[Zero Command]], recruited<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the crew of<ref name="Who's Who" /> [[Batch's task force]]. The second in command took the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that composed the task force and joined Harssk's<ref name="NEC" /> splinter kindgom,<ref name="Who's Who" /> Zero Command.<ref name="TEA" />
